htmlPath.description: Path to the interactive diagram .html produced by generate_html_diagram or diagram_render.

pngPath.description: If set, write a static PNG figure here (motion frozen).

gifPath.description: If set, write an animated GIF here.

svgPath.description: If set, write a self-contained ANIMATED SVG here (vector, flow-dot animation preserved). For your own site/embed — NOT the AWS Blog/WordPress, which blocks SVG upload.

mode.description: GIF content: 'flow' = one looping segment of the animated data flow; 'walkthrough' = one animated segment per guided beat (requires the HTML to have `steps`), concatenated into a looping tour. PNG/SVG are unaffected.

period.description: flow mode: GIF loop length in seconds; every edge's flow dot shares this exact period so the loop closes seamlessly. (For the sharpest loop, also pass the SAME value as flowPeriod to generate_html_diagram.)

frames.description: flow mode: frames captured across one period (GIF smoothness).

beatDuration.description: walkthrough mode: seconds held on each beat.

beatFrames.description: walkthrough mode: frames captured per beat.
